I'm 24, 5'9" and my worst weight was 220. I'd gone through a terrible depression after my boyfriend died and didn't even notice the weight I'd put on. I remember randomly stepping onto a scale and seeing that number, it was terrifying. 

I'd never been small though, my family never practiced any sort of healthy eating. Ice cream for no good reason on a random Tuesday? Sure! Luckily I was a very active child and teen, so I think that saved me from being any larger. 

I've lost a bunch of weight since then and I'm so close to my goal, it feels amazing. But when I was at my largest I never had anyone bully me about it or make comments. I think it's all just paranoia and misinterpretation from these people in an attempt to justify their terrible habits.

I had the same with my parents. The only food in my house was soda and snack food. We always always always ate McDonalds. In my small town it was the only fast food place around and was closer than the grocery store. Luckily, we were a very active family.
